items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee mentions 'Amos and Andy' as the title of a picture/movie and a comedy vehicle, but does not describe a personal relationship with the individuals named Andy (or Amos).

ctx.x: Oh, with Harry James -- I did one with Harry James and I did one with Duke, naturally. The first one was with Duke with the Amos and Andy picture.
